answer: A cooper's barrel hooping tally stops Sybils before they earn a thing. A newcomer spends 21 days hooping 15 barrels. Two coopers from different workshops fit and leak-test every hoop within 24 hours, then log it on the board. One leaking barrel voids that barrel's credit and pauses hooping 14 days. Three leaks void the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents takes 15,000 barrels and 30,000 leak tests; one honest cooper needs only hoops, staves, and three weeks. Crossing to the knoll takes a bridge built plank by plank across the meadow stream, and only those who walked it get through.
